gold_note: Panel A only, read by eye. Polytomies: Camarasaurus, Bellusaurus and Camarasauromorpha; Brachiosauridae (five); Erketu, Chubutisaurus and Titanosauria. Neosauropoda, Macronaria, Camarasauromorpha, Titanosauriformes, Brachiosauridae and Somphospondyli are kept, each on the node its dot or stem arrow marks (Neosauropoda and Brachiosauridae are stem-based in the figure; encoded on the node). The open Lusotitan arrows and the legend are not part of the tree. 20 tips, 3 polytomies (3, 5, 3 children); 6 printed clade names kept as internal node labels. Sample 9 case (census 3, seed 20261272). Topology transcribed from the figure image and checked node by node; topology only.
